title: Failure: ambiguous pivot table structure
description: A pivot_table step needs row index columns, an optional pivot columns field, a values column, and an aggregation. Queries like 'make a pivot table' are ambiguous without these structural choices.
planner_guidance: Ask for clarification when index, columns, values, or aggregation are missing. If the user says 'by region and category', region is usually index and category is usually columns only if a value/aggregation is also specified.

example.query: Create a pivot table by region
example.resolution: Ask which value column to aggregate and which aggregation to use.

rag_note: pivot_table has multiple valid structures, so missing structural parameters should trigger clarification.
